Scores of '''shock projectors''' covered the ridges of a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. The projectors delivered a powerful and painful [[Stun/Legends|stun]] charge that was capable of paralyzing a target for several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="EGWT" />
